about_the_game:
"Mona: The Endless Journey Demo" Experience Instructions

"Mona: The Endless Journey Demo" (hereinafter referred to as the "Demo version") is now open. The content of this test focuses on the core segments of the game's "Underground Sea" chapter, unlocking the key gameplay and plot threads of this chapter for players in advance.

I. Core Experience Content

  • Experience Duration: The estimated single - complete - experience duration of the Demo version is 30 to 60 minutes. Specifically, there will be individual differences according to the player's puzzle - solving rhythm and combat strategies.

  • Gameplay Coverage: Players can deeply experience the pre - sequence level content of the "Underground Sea" chapter, including scene exploration, the cracking of core puzzles, and the complete battle process of the first BOSS of this chapter, and comprehensively feel the level - design logic and combat mechanisms.

  • Free - Exploration Rights: Different from the linear closed - loop design of traditional Demos, after players complete the first BOSS challenge in this Demo, the experience process will not automatically terminate. Players can inherit the current save file, freely return to the unlocked scenes for supplementary exploration, combat practice, or repeatedly refine the BOSS - battle strategies.

II. Scenes and Plot of the "Underground Sea" Chapter

The scene narrative opening of the Demo version: The protagonist wakes up in a red pool, and is then dragged deep underground by several mysterious black giant hands. When she wakes up again, she is in a vast and eerie black ocean - this is the core area of the "Underground Sea". Here is shrouded in hazy fog all year round, the environment is damp and cold, and the sea surface has a viscous black sheen.

At the plot level, the Demo will guide players to initially access the mysterious life - experience clues of the "girl in white", and plant the key foreshadowing of the bonding stories among partners. The subsequent complete plot threads will be gradually uncovered in the official version.

III. Test Instructions

  • Version Nature: The Demo version opened this time is a product of the game's testing stage. The content integrity, picture performance, system functions, etc. do not represent the final - launch quality of the game.

  • Subsequent Optimization: The development team will, according to the feedback from this test, conduct continuous iteration and improvement on the game system (including operation feel, UI interaction, numerical balance, etc.).

  • Experience Tips: During the test, if there are situations such as incomplete functions and unsmooth experiences, please understand, players. And you are also welcome to give valuable feedback through official channels to help improve the game quality.

short_description: *Mona: The Endless Journey* is a 3D side-scrolling action RPG. Players play a fragile pillow-carrying girl, adventuring in a fantasy continent. They rescue powerful companions, traverse mysteries, solve puzzles, fight eerie creatures, and uncover the world’s hidden truth.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
